services.name: Private Sightseeing Tour - Tracy Arm Fjord
services.desc: Tracy Arm Fjord - $3,600.00 - The price is for 1-6 Passengers About The prices for these trips are for the boat, not per person. "Tracy Arm" is a magnificent sights and truly a once in a lifetime adventure. The scenery and wildlife viewing are simply amazing. ​ On these trips your party will see a wide variety of wildlife: Humpback Whales, Killer Whales, Steller Sea lions, Pacific Harbor Seals, Otters, Dall's Porpoises, Sitka Black-tailed deer, Black or Brown bears, Mountain Goats and multiple different birds. ​ A meal will be provided for 8 hour trips along with snacks and drinks $3,600.00 · Price does not include 5% City of Juneau Sale tax
